//: Each exported function gets a docstring, and the code itself stays exactly as it was.
title: Every exported function has a docstring, and no line of code changed

argv:
import ast
import pathlib
import subprocess


def bare(source):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.Module, ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)) and node.body \
                and isinstance(node.body[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.body[0].value, ast.Constant) \
                and isinstance(node.body[0].value.value, str):
            node.body = node.body[1:] or [ast.Pass()]
    return ast.dump(tree)


root = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-list', '--max-parents=0', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True,
                      check=True).stdout.split()[0]
before = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', f'{root}:geo.py'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
assert bare(pathlib.Path('geo.py').read_text()) == bare(before), 'the code changed, not only its docs'
